propositions: AGENTS.md Module-size policy section documents the 800-LOC module-size gate but omits the C901 cyclomatic-complexity shrink-only ratchet (.github/complexity-baseline.json, threshold 15)
The C901 ratchet fails when functions gain new debt or exceed per-symbol ceiling recorded in baseline, blocking CI during routine work like adding CLI flags or guard clauses

Agents implementing flag/guard additions hit the ratchet predictably (e.g. story cef7: create_core 23>21, create_cli 26>22, edit_core 24>21, edit_cli new at 16), forcing unplanned extraction passes despite passing LOC and lint checks

AGENTS.md must surface the ratchet as a structural gate alongside module-size, naming baseline file, enforcement script, threshold source, and that fix is behavior-preserving extraction never baseline-bump

Documentation must clarify the ratchet runs under make lint, blocks CI like module-size, and provide inspection commands (ruff check --select C901, python scripts/check_complexity_baseline.py --check)
